title: Transanimation
summary: TRANSANIMA'TION, noun [Latin trans and anima.] Conveyance of the soul from one body to another; transmigration. [The latter is the word generally used.]

inlines.v: TRANSANIMA'TION, noun [Latin trans and anima.] Conveyance of the soul from one body to another; transmigration. [The latter is the word generally used.]
